description:
Mast has longed to hit the high seas ever since she first saw the swashbuckling adventures portrayed in pirate films as a child.
As time drew on, however, her soul-crushing tenure at the Naval Squad slowly made her disillusioned.
Even so, her vibrant personality remains untarnished, and she always brightens everyone else's day aboard the ship she serves.

lines.text: Check out my parrot, his name's Morgan. Isn't he awesome?
One of these days, Morgan and I are gonna go check out the ocean.
Morgan cracks me up whenever he does a trick.
Morgan and I are on a hunt for buried treasure. Wanna join us?
So long as I've got my feathered friend with me, I'm practically invincible. We'll protect you, Captain.

Isn't this birdbrain adorable?
Almost as cute as you, Captain.
Where did you go? I'm losing my mind waiting here.
I'll prepare a bountiful feast, complete with rum, before the Captain arrives.
If Helm or Anchor come looking for me, you never saw me.

Is there no ocean here either?
*Sigh* When will I ever set my eyes on the open sea?
Which way to the swimming pool?
Mast is my name, and being a pirate is my game! Together, you and I will find a treasure island.
A pirate must be strong.

Thanks for all the help!
I'll make it worth your while.
Thanks to you, I'll be a pirate whose escapades will go down in history.
This isn't rum by chance, is it?
Next time I unearth a treasure chest, I'll give you a share of the booty.
Thanks! This is the first time anyone's ever given me a gift.

I feel good when I see you, Captain. 
Like I've had one too many swigs of rum.
You're all right in my book. I'll even share my rations with you.
Say, um... would you ever consider going out with a pirate?
Are we finally taking to the high seas?
Awaiting your orders.
Aye Aye, Captain.
Trust me. I'm the finest helmsman on the seven seas.
I'll show you what a true pirate can do.
The ocean is calling us!
Might there be some gold coins awaiting us?
Reload!
Just a sip of rum...!
Don't pester me.
Morgan, are you ready?
I'll send you down to Davy Jones's locker!
Give up all your booty!
Aye Aye, Captain. Taken care of!
Arrrr!
That was almost too easy...
Gasp...!
Ouch!
Ow!
I'm sorry for failing you, Captain.
Shiver me timbers! We won!

Haha! Dreams never fade, Captain,
not even underwater!

I wonder what treasures lie in the ocean depths!
I can't wait to discover them myself!
Morgan, why don't we take this chance to befriend some sea creatures?
If I do manage to uncover some treasure, I'll make sure you get the lion's share! But just keep this from Morgan!

As long as you're with me, I'm not afraid of anything,
not even the deep ocean!

It'd be a shame to witness the beauty of this underwater world alone.
How about you join me, Captain?
At this rate, Captain, we're liable to lose the treasure.
Captain, what's your favorite type of treasure? Hmm... I need to mull this over.
Hmm... Isn't there somewhere even deeper than a swimming pool?
After going through all that trouble to put on a diving suit, and there's no ocean here? What a bummer.

Why am I wearing this suit, you ask?
Because one must always be prepared!

Mast, ready to dive!
Why don't you and I go searching for deep sea treasure together?
I must find a shipwreck full of treasures to repay you!
Thanks to you, I can dive even deeper now!
Now I feel safe even without the oxygen tank!
What shipwreck did you get this treasure from?
A gift from you is more precious than any treasure, Captain.
Thank you! I'll give you a gift if I find something awesome during my dive.
If you were to ever fall overboard, I'd dive in to save you without hesitation.
With you by my side, I feel like I can dive even deeper into the ocean!
I'm so happy. I feel like I can hand over all my treasure right now!
This is my moment!
Have you discovered something?
Be careful over there!
Let's see... Where's that treasure hiding?
Can we at least take a swig of rum before going in?
The map is pointing this way!
The treasure is calling out to us!
I'll load up!
All the equipment is still fine.
Decompressing now!
Are you ready to dive, Morgan?
Nothing beats a shot of rum after a successful dive!
Everyone, hold your breath and give it all you got!
Follow me!
Rest in peace.
Where's the treasure?
Ugh...!
Argh!
Aak!
*Cough* I hope the sea... will lead the way...
Now that that's taken care of, can we get back into the sea?
